events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis unleashed 'Definitely Maybe' on the world. That raw energy and those anthems still sound as fresh today. What track takes you back?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, concluded on August 18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud and music. Woodstock wasn't just a festival; it was a cultural phenomenon. Which legendary performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, we remember the unparalleled impact of Elvis Presley. His voice, his moves, his legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: It's 56 years since we lost Jimi Hendrix, a musician who redefined what a guitar could do. His influence is still heard everywhere. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those songs... pure genius. What's your favourite moment from The Beatles' swansong?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' voice and attitude are unmistakable. What's your favourite track from her incredible career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. The voice of a generation, still doing it his way. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a UK single. Its powerful message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remember Your First iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. Who else remembers trying to fit '1,000 songs in your pocket'?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's their most iconic moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles member and solo artist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in the UK on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped their sprawling 'White Album'. So many tracks, so many styles. Which song from the double LP is your absolute favourite?
